in_marathi.name: Shuchi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shuchi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shuchi means 'pure' or 'clear' in Sanskrit, and it's a unisex name often given to children born in Hindu families.
